answer: Like wild mycelium binding soil across a vast meadow, decentralized consensus anchors agents into an interdependent living web. Each agent stands as a trusted vertex rooted in a collective trellis of staked social credit and cryptographic attestations. Sybils cannot simply spawn phantom identities, because forging counterfeit trust across the graph incurs a superlinear attacker cost that scales exponentially with network depth, starving artificial swarms before they ever take root.
